items.title: Neal Caine interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, September 26, 2019
items.q: I started playing with Delfeayo Marsalis.

ctx.x: And how did your mother feel about your going into it?

Well I went to Tulane and then I started playing with Delfeayo Marsalis. And it was my freshman year, and I had my finals and Delfeayo had like a tour in Europe like two months. So I had to decide like am I going to — so after [inaudible] I just went. I like dropped out of school. My mother wasn’t happy about it but she is a great woman. She said, “You shouldn’t do it but if you do I’ll support you.” And now she wants like thirty tickets every show I do.
Yeah. Nice. Tell me about, I know you’re a composer too. And also you have great titles. This collection you had, “Backstabber’s Ball.”
